mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping preserves reconstruction from incomplete dated traces through cross-checked records to supported custody links and explicit gaps. Tracking BD and O1 separately preserves object identity; the inference remains bounded by incomplete transfers, possible common origins and mistaken identification.

target_fidelity.rationale: Establishing official possession of the awarded bidder's draft before tender publication contributes bounded evidence relevant to possible bidder influence. The mapping explicitly stops short of establishing motive, clause authorship or intentional steering, consistent with the question asking what can be established.

operational_coherence.rationale: The authenticated records permit the stated chronology: p2 independently establishes official receipt of the complete BD on day 3, while p3 and p4 document official editing and public registration of O1 on days 4 and 5. Cross-checking these records supports possession and timing without equating the documents or proving transmission of particular wording. The supplied records and budget accommodate the bounded procedure.

validity.rationale: All three criteria pass. Document-level provenance supplies a justified, explicitly limited contribution to the steering investigation without claiming that possession establishes intentional influence.

uncertainty: The records do not establish motive or rule out an unrecorded common origin.
The mapped document-level reconstruction does not establish clause authorship or whether bidder input caused the procurement outcome.
Missing custody links remain unresolved; their absence does not establish that no transfer occurred.
